construct: Maffucci syndrome combines multiple enchondromas with vascular lesions and is associated with somatic mosaic IDH1 or IDH2 mutations. Mutant IDH acquires neomorphic activity that reduces alpha-ketoglutarate to the oncometabolite 2-hydroxyglutarate, altering cellular differentiation and epigenetic regulation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Multiple enchondromas plus soft-tissue vascular lesions and a shared somatic mosaic IDH1 mutation identify Maffucci syndrome; mutant IDH acquires neomorphic 2-hydroxyglutarate-producing activity.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Homogentisate oxidase, methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, collagen prolyl hydroxylation, and pyruvate carboxylase are unrelated metabolic reactions and do not represent mutant-IDH neomorphic activity.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The lesion pattern identifies Maffucci syndrome and the shared IDH mutation fixes the tested biochemical reaction; no alternative option operates through mutant IDH.
